Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art overworld sprite sheet for a 2.5D Pokemon fangame.
Create a NEW sprite sheet of LEAF, the female Pokemon FireRed/LeafGreen playable trainer, reinterpreted in the exact pixel density, overhead camera angle, chibi proportions, dark selective outlines and shading of the Pokemon Black/White overworld characters in the supplied style reference. Preserve Leaf's recognizable large white sunhat with red band, long light brown hair, blue sleeveless shirt, short red skirt, dark socks, white shoes and small yellow shoulder bag. This is one character only.
The reference image is STYLE ONLY; do not copy the reference sheet layout or its characters.
OUTPUT: transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no labels, no borders, no visible grid. Canvas portrait 768x1024. EXACTLY twelve sprites arranged in a perfectly even 3-column x 4-row grid, each invisible cell 256x256. Sprite is originally 32x32 logical pixel art enlarged exactly 8x with nearest-neighbor block pixels. Each sprite about 20 pixels wide and 28 pixels high, feet centered at local logical pixel (16,29), identical scale in all cells, with transparent margin.
ROW 1 faces DOWN toward viewer. ROW 2 faces UP away from viewer (back of hat/hair). ROW 3 faces LEFT. ROW 4 faces RIGHT.
In EVERY row, COLUMN 1 walking with left foot forward, COLUMN 2 neutral standing with feet together, COLUMN 3 walking with right foot forward. Alternate arms and feet for a real three-frame walk cycle, head/outfit identity stable. Side profiles actually face the required direction. Do not duplicate the standing pose in walking columns. Strictly no illustration rendering, no anti-aliased vector style, no high-resolution facial detail, no realistic proportions. Match the tiny Nintendo DS game sprites of the reference.
